text: My stepdaughter is 3 months old and her temperature is 40°C, I've checked it twice. I'm really scared. The soft spot on top of her head is sticking up, bulging out, and it isn't usually like that. Earlier she bumped her head on the edge of the table. She cried straight away and since then she's been acting completely normal, so I don't know if it's from that or something else. Her mum's at work and I can't reach her. Please tell me what to do
